root_cause_found_this_run: The manifest-driven WARC recovery wrapper previously treated only archive pages labelled unresolved as targets. That can silently skip a missing auction when another auction on the same page has a surviving catalogue anchor. Page-level completeness is therefore not a valid proxy for canonical lot-level coverage.
